THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
100
Behind the image
79 / Ribbed Cami
REFERENCE 5961.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 057
Art direction: Black against pale grey-green walls, soft, slightly high-key light and an intimate,
relaxed seated pose.
Photorealistic vertical seated editorial portrait of an original adult woman with very long, loosely
waved dark brown hair falling over her shoulders, soft bangs, a calm, slightly downcast gaze and
soft red lips. She wears a fitted black ribbed camisole dress with thin straps, with a long side-slit
black skirt. Her hands rest together on one knee, and a large dark grey leather bag fills the right
edge of the frame. Pale grey-green plaster wall with a low beige paneled base, soft even window
light, black and neutral palette, clean fabric rib texture, minimal street-style editorial, no text or
logos.
80 / Denim Mini
REFERENCE 5958.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 057
Art direction: Cream and light denim against deep blue upholstery, bright showroom light and a
casual, poised stance.
Photorealistic full-length vertical lifestyle portrait of an original adult woman seated on the edge of
a deep blue upholstered bench, long straight dark hair with soft wispy bangs, a calm, composed
gaze and soft red lips, arms folded across her chest. She wears a cream ribbed fitted turtleneck, a
light-wash denim mini skirt with a button front, and knee-high black suede boots with flat soles,
with small silver hoop earrings. Bright retail interior with a pale wooden floor, a red clothing rail
with quilted jackets and denim pieces, and a dark wall with folded knitwear on shelves, soft even
store lighting, cream, denim and navy palette, clean contemporary fashion editorial, no text or
logos.
